note: Not a German club and not a 3. Liga club. The only reason it reaches this map is a league tag on its Wikidata item pointing at Q154069, the German 3. Liga. The club is the Swiss SC Veltheim from the Veltheim district of Winterthur, registered with the Fussballverband Region Zuerich as club 1556 and playing in the Swiss 2. Liga, so that tag is a wrong link - most likely the Swiss 3. Liga was meant. Established 2026-09-18 from two web searches agreeing on the club, its town and its league; the fvrz.ch and Wikipedia pages themselves could not be opened from the machine that checked this, so re-read them before relying on the Swiss league named here. The skip itself does not depend on it: whichever Swiss league is meant, the club does not belong on a German tier-3 map.
